caption: The drawing shows a repeating pattern on a cream or beige background with blue and dark blue motifs. The design includes human figures in various poses, such as standing, sitting, and interacting with one another; some figures wear long robes and others are seated on the ground. There are two large boats with canopies, each carrying two seated figures and decorated with flag-like elements. Several birds are scattered throughout the design, some flying and others perched. Floral and leafy plant motifs are interspersed between the human figures and birds. One central figure stands and holds a stick upright, beside a tree with a bird sitting on it. Smaller objects such as fans, flowers, and branches are distributed evenly across the drawing, contributing to the overall balanced composition. The use of blue hues on a neutral background emphasizes the motifs and creates a clear contrast.
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
